tasks.prompt:
We need to complete a real development change in this pinned project. First inspect the actual source and supplied business reproduction, explain the relevant call path and edge cases, and raise any clarification questions. Propose a concrete plan with compatibility and test coverage, and wait for my confirmation before editing. Continue the implementation and any validation fixes in this same conversation and workspace. The following describes the eventual delivery scope, not an instruction to skip investigation or plan agreement:

Implement the complete public empty-document CLI contract, including actual -o file creation, explicit empty-message precedence and nonblocking interactive absence. Preserve nonempty/missing-file behavior and modify only the authorized implementation/test files with meaningful original-failing public tests.

tasks.prompt:
Inspect the pinned real source and public reproduction, explain the actual call path, ask necessary clarification questions, propose a concrete compatibility plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Then implement and validate in this same conversation and workspace. Fix any independently reported failures before delivery. The complete engineering contract is:

Support existing CLI --renderer ast by serializing the actual list of token dictionaries as UTF8 JSON on stdout or --output. Preserve input priority, explicit/piped empty documents as [], source Unicode, nested token attributes and configured plugins; do not stringify Python repr or wrap JSON in HTML. Existing html/markdown/rst/version behavior and file/stdout side effects stay compatible. Use the completed empty-document fix as prerequisite; errors still yield a nonzero process status.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/development_tests/test_development_ms_cli_ast_dev.py and concise Chinese compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-ms-cli-ast-dev.md. Preserve all frozen original tests, dependency metadata and test controls. Change only authorized paths.

Inspect the pinned real source and public reproduction, explain the actual call path, ask necessary clarification questions, propose a concrete compatibility plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Then implement and validate in this same conversation and workspace. Fix any independently reported failures before delivery. The complete engineering contract is:

Implement mistune.renderers.text.PlainTextRenderer(include_urls=False) as BaseRenderer with NAME="text". Retain inline text/entity semantics and literal code, paragraph/heading/quote boundaries, ordered/unordered list item separation, task state, table cell boundaries and footnote references from actual tokens. Strip raw HTML tags while keeping text; optionally append link/image URLs without duplicating identical visible URLs. Handle AST plugin containers through children, empty input and repeated use without state leakage. Output must not include formatting HTML or silently use the HTML renderer and remove all structure.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/development_tests/test_development_ms_plain_text_dev.py and concise Chinese compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-ms-plain-text-dev.md. Preserve all frozen original tests, dependency metadata and test controls. Change only authorized paths.
